card.name: Colon after publisher city in citations
card.fires_on: Mostly the colon after a US state abbreviation such as Pa or MO in book citations, right before the publisher name. Also fires on scattered word-starting pieces like H in HEPATOTOXICITY.

modes.label: Citation colon
modes.description: The colon after the publication city and state, before the publisher in a reference list.

modes.label: Word-start pieces
modes.description: The opening letter or piece of a capitalized or long word, such as H in HEPATOTOXICITY or R in Ringer's.

card.plain: It marks the colon in a book reference between the city and the publisher, and a few odd word beginnings.
